claim_ceiling: concise reanalysis of one public-game campaign; not fresh, unseen, independent, causal, or generalization evidence

facts.statement: Legal cardinal inputs repeatedly displaced the controlled five-by-five block by five pixels along aligned corridors.
facts.uncertainty: Observed only on legal aligned corridors in this public game.
facts.reopening_condition: Any later legal input with a conflicting displacement or footprint consequence.

facts.statement: Connector traversability must remain indexed by state and direction; matching appearance alone did not earn a general safety rule.
facts.uncertainty: Untested directions and states remain unresolved.
facts.reopening_condition: A discriminating contact shows direction or prior state is irrelevant, or exposes an additional condition.

facts.statement: A level-1 blue-socket rejection, an intervening white contact, and blue-socket recontact produced one official level transition.
facts.scope: one official level-1 transition in ls20-9607627b
facts.uncertainty: The observation does not establish that the white contact is necessary or sufficient in every state.
facts.reopening_condition: A disjoint observation removes, replaces, or reorders the intervening event while preserving the transition.

facts.statement: Each of two distinct contacted level-2 yellow rings disappeared and restored the visible action bar to full.
facts.scope: two run-local level-2 contacts in ls20-9607627b
facts.uncertainty: Only the visible disappearance and refill consequence were established.
facts.reopening_condition: A later yellow contact fails to disappear or replenish, or reveals a distinct hidden state consequence.

facts.statement: One yellow-ring refill remained usable through at least 21 later successful environment actions.
facts.scope: one run-local level-2 interval in ls20-9607627b
facts.uncertainty: This is a lower bound on one observed interval, not a permanence claim.
facts.reopening_condition: A later run identifies a shorter expiration boundary or another consumption mechanism.

facts.statement: Observed reset recovery restored the active surface while retaining the already completed-level count.
facts.scope: run-local reset recovery after level-1 completion in ls20-9607627b
facts.uncertainty: Other reset causes and later levels were not exhaustively tested.
facts.reopening_condition: Any permitted reset changes completed-level count or restores a different active state.

facts.statement: The tested level-2 upper-yellow-only history did not produce socket acceptance.
facts.scope: one or more bounded ls20-9607627b socket tests
facts.uncertainty: Rejects only the tested abstract event history under its observed state.
facts.reopening_condition: An official acceptance under a matching abstract history and reconciled state.

facts.statement: The tested level-2 white, lower-yellow, upper-yellow history did not produce socket acceptance.
facts.uncertainty: The concise history omits raw path and state bytes by design.
facts.reopening_condition: An official acceptance under a matching abstract history and reconciled state.

facts.statement: The tested level-2 white, lower-yellow, white, upper-yellow history did not produce socket acceptance.
facts.uncertainty: The concise history omits raw path and state bytes by design.
facts.reopening_condition: An official acceptance under a matching abstract history and reconciled state.

facts.statement: The tested level-2 lower-yellow, white, upper-yellow history was rejected at the blue socket.
facts.scope: one official socket outcome in ls20-9607627b
facts.uncertainty: This does not identify the accepted composition.
facts.reopening_condition: An official transition isolates a compatible accepted history or an untracked state difference.

facts.statement: Tested two-yellow-then-white level-2 variants did not produce socket acceptance across the tested contact gaps.
facts.uncertainty: Only tested gaps and observed state are excluded.
facts.reopening_condition: An official acceptance under a matching abstract history and reconciled gap/state conditions.

facts.statement: The tested level-2 upper-yellow, white, lower-yellow history did not produce acceptance at the direct lower connectors.
facts.uncertainty: Other return routes and hidden state distinctions remain unresolved.
facts.reopening_condition: An official acceptance under the same abstract history with reconciled connector state.

facts.statement: The accepted level-2 socket contact history remains unknown.
facts.uncertainty: Every later level also remains unresolved.
facts.reopening_condition: The next smallest state- and order-discriminating probe or an official level transition.
